Success callback stops velocity, sets x20 and clears x221E_b6 before Squeezing0.
Animation-end success/failure branch and later destination consumer.
Separate active Squeeze and subsequent throw selection.

reason: Canonical entry bodies, Grab completion/success paths and Squeezing consumers support the preparatory sequence mapping and cross-file flow. Held-opponent sequence describes the family, not a guarantee of a victim on Squeezing1: x20 != 1 routes to Fail. Neither owned entry applies damage or throws.
